assessments.summary: Measles cases in the US are peaking with a 225% increase in weekly reports over the past 8 months, and news coverage is rising sharply.
Dengue cases in the US are peaking with a 1003% increase in weekly reports over the past 8 months, and news coverage is rising sharply.
Polio cases in Syria are reported with a cluster of four acute flaccid paralysis cases in Deir Ez Zor Governorate, and WHO has confirmed circulating vaccine-derived poliovirus type 1.
Global flu test positivity is rising with a 32% increase over the past month, and US flu hospital admissions are up 55% compared to the previous month.
Whooping cough cases in the US are rising with a 52% increase in weekly reports over the past 8 months, and news coverage is rising sharply.
Mpox cases in the US are rising with a 100% increase in weekly reports over the past 8 months, and news coverage is rising sharply.
US COVID-19 hospital admissions are rising with a 13% increase over the past month, and Wikipedia readership is at a very low level.
Global RSV test positivity is rising with a 27% increase over the past month, and US RSV hospital admissions are up 57% compared to the previous month.
Malaria cases in the US have stabilized at baseline with a 52/100 score, showing a slight increase in reported cases this year compared to last year.
West Nile virus cases in the US are rising sharply with a 51/100 score, indicating a significant increase in reported cases this year compared to last year.
Human metapneumovirus (hMPV) has seen a spike in news coverage with a 51/100 score, reflecting increased public attention but no significant change in reported cases.
Chikungunya cases in the US are stable with a 49/100 score, but there are new locally acquired cases reported in Switzerland.
Cholera has stable cases with a 45/100 score, but there is increased news coverage and Wikipedia readership.
Ebola cases are stable with a 45/100 score, but there are ongoing outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Kenya, and Nigeria.
Legionnaires' disease cases in the US are stable with a 43/100 score, showing a slight increase in reported cases this year compared to last year.
